name: MEA Local — GraphQL Aggregation Gateway (Quarkus, SmallRye GraphQL)
_comment: FORWARD-REFERENCE (order-plan.md S7+, not yet exercised by S2): points the SAME behavior-equivalence suite's staged 'GraphQL Gateway Contract' folder (added PENDING at S2, DRQ-069/DRQ-071) at the as-yet-nonexistent examples/08-graphql-gateway (:8090) once it is scaffolded in S7. UNLIKE every other forward-reference environment in this directory, this one does NOT set {{baseUrl}} — the gateway is additive and sits alongside the strangler proxy with its OWN front door (DRQ-069: aggregation, not Apollo federation, so it is not routed through the strangler seam), so the collection's GG-a/GG-b requests target the dedicated {{graphqlGatewayBaseUrl}} collection variable instead (default 'http://localhost:8090' already in mea.postman_collection.json's own variable array; this environment file lets a local run override it the same way local.postman_environment.json overrides baseUrl). Loading this environment alone does NOT enable the staged folder — that also requires flipping the graphqlGatewayEnabled COLLECTION variable to 'true', which newman's --env-var/--global-var flags cannot reach (verified empirically for the identical shippingSagaEnabled gate, see demos/lib/run-shipping-newman.js's header comment); enabling the folder for real at S7/S8 needs the same Node-API in-memory-patch helper pattern (a future demos/lib/run-order-newman.js modeled on run-shipping-newman.js), not --env-var and not this environment file by itself.
